The only thing I can complain is that basically you do a lot of writing works/feedbacks/tasks, so it is at some point a bit hard to keep track of every deadline, but Dr. Hossein helps a lot for that matter.
As a COMD student, I found this course unnecessary. I wish this course was elective, not obligatory.

There is too much to do and it is not creative at all. We always had to follow prompts that were given. Also, considering that this was originally an ELIT course I expected to write many different kinds of writings. All we did was to write paragraphs and short stories. I liked Mr Dabir's teaching style but his workload was too much.

The course is rather fun, especially if you take it from Hossein Dabir. But it agitated me a lot because of the constant deadlines we have to follow. It's kind of like Turkish 101 and 102 in that respect. So it was overwhelming to always check whether we uploaded our tasks. The course contains a lot of interesting articles that give new perspectives on topics we may already know, so that was good.
Son aşamada yaptığımız reflective presentation bence anlamsız ve sacmaydı(essay şeklinde yazmak yeterliydi)
assistant: No there wasn't but I think there should be for Dabir's sake. The workload was too much for us that I can't imagine how much he spends his time on our writings.

instructor: he is the sweetest
You are a great instructor. I am so happy that I met you. I am sorry but I will write negative comments about class. But this is not about you. You are such a nice person.

Hossein Dabir is not aware of the fact that this is a creative writing course. He confuses it with his ENG 101-102 courses. In all the tasks and assignments, his only concern was whether the student follows the prompt, exactly imitates the examples he offered, and organizes his work according to the guidelines. There has been no space for creativity. As a matter of fact, creativity is always punished. 

All responsibilities of the instructor were done by the students. Throughout the semester, the students conducted discussions and presentations. The students gave each other feedback for their tasks and assignments. The instructor only made a few comments in the discussions and presentations, which was not helpful. The feedback he provided for our tasks was nothing more than a few general comments on trivial issues. These comments were generally full of spelling mistakes, which shows the attention he gave to our works while reading and commenting on them.
He's really fun and interesting
I love Dabir. He is fun, respectful and knows the student well. However, in this course, he expected a lot of small works, and that was hard to keep track of them.
course: Not even closely related to COMD. Not creative as in course title. Garbage

The whole course is based on student discussions and presentations. Is this an oral presentation course? The workload for presentations almost exceeds the writing tasks. This is very ridiculous considering that the course is named creative writing.
I think this course requires lots of work load

The course continued with student discussions after week 1 or 2, and I think it was weird. I understand he wants to participate us in the class because we are doing creative stuff, but I prefer him to explain more rather than let the students do all the things. I can say, the student gives the lecture.

Ders tamamen bir saçmalık. Dabir tüm iyi niyeti ve saygısıyla dersi eleştirebileceğimizi ve değişime gidebileceğimizi söyledi. Lakin ders öylesine alakasız ve faydasız ki nasıl değiştirirseniz değiştirin bir vakit kaybından öteye gidemez. Dolasıyla dersin kesinlikle müfredattan kaldırılması gerekiyor diye düşünüyorum. Asla bir COMD dersi değil. Bizim hocalarımızın hobilerine göre koyduğu derslerden biri. Hocamız için ayrıca bir şeyler söyleyeyim, keşke COMD'de hoca olsaydı, ondan ders almak için sıra olurdu. Mükemmel bir hoca.

instructor: He is an angel. After he understands you, and your style of writing, he gives you everything he knows. He is the best.
Great teacher, I loved his course!

he gives us thought-stimulating tasks that reveal the best of us. creativity cannot be taught, and still, Mr. Dabir finds the most effective way of revealing our creativity. I am grateful to him as he stirred up the desire to write and to speak my mind.
BEST TEACHER ON CAMPUS!
course: I think the format of the course is nice, gives the students everything and do not bother the student. We learned a lot thanks to Dabir.
There is a little bit of an excessive workload, but since the course is fun it wasn't much of a problem.
It was both very instructive and fun if you are into creative writing.
Theoretical and practical course that helped me understand and learn, practice and improve.
Dersin olumlu yönü stres yöntemi hakkında fikir sahibi olmak olabilir, gereksiz uzunluktaki ödev yükü bıktırdı. Bu ders zorunlu olmadıkça alınmamalı, öğretici yanı yok ödev yükü haricinde.

instructor: The instructor is extremely supportive, but he expects a lot from students. If you are genuinely interested in creative writing or at least willing to work hard, Hossein Dabir is your best option.

Professor Dabir is my favorite teacher Bilkent, so I really do not have anything to criticize him. He is like a father, rather than a teacher. He always tries to help his students to do their best. I feel like I can always talk to him about any problem. I think he is too much for Bilkent. He is a perfect instructor, and I am very lucky to take this course from him.

He is good at lecturing and listening.
He is very bad at "creative" side of the the course. Our opinions doesn't matter, we have to change our essays according to his wishes. The course itself was supposed to encourage creativity.
Açıkçası karantina döneminde online olarak alınan bu derste tek yaptığımız ödev yapmaktı. Başka bir şey öğrenmedik.
course: The weakest point of this course was definitely the restrictions and word limits. If this is a "creative" course, these restrictions are acting as a way to narrow our possibilities and our imagination.
İlgisi olmayan insanlara zorunlulukla verilen bu ders diğer derslerimi de etkiledi. Yorucuydu ve gerçekten zorlayıcıydı. Bir şey öğrendiğimi düşünmüyorum.

Throughout the semester, we have done a lot of things, and sometimes I could not focus them all. We have to come up with a unique story in a very short amount of time. I sometimes experienced a lot of stress because of the workload. Also, in our last story, I think it would be better if our professor gives us feedback rather than the students because some of us received detailed feedback, but some of us did not.
The course may seem simple, but I have learned so much throughout the semester and it was demanding. I think it really helped me be a better writer, thinker, and speaker.

Since it's a writing course it offers advance-level grammar.
Yet the course has nothing to do with creativity, moodle instruction clearly stated that we have to avoid using cliche statements but when we wrote our first story it turn out to be a mess.
